{{Quote|Uh, compliments of the lizard in the back.|The bartender offers a drink to Asajj Ventress from [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]]|<ref name="Bounty (episode)">{{TCW|Bounty (episode)}}</ref>}}
A '''Nimbanel male''' worked as a [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] at [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Sometime around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the bartender anticipated a fight between [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Notluwiski Papanoida/Legends|Notluwiski Papanoida]], [[Ion Papanoida/Legends|Ion Papanoida]] and a group of thugs and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]. During the ensuing skirmish he sought cover under the bar along with a [[Unidentified Gotal bounty hunter|Gotal bounty hunter]].

A while after, the cantina was also visited by former [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], who killed [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Oked/Legends|Oked]] when he tried flirting with her. The bartender was later seen dragging Oked's body out of the cantina.

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|And also, we rationalize that the same owner probably didn't have it. So we created a bartender for our cantina. And I think that this guy was so traumatized by the shootout with Baron Papanoida that he put the cantina up for sale.|Series Director [[Dave Filoni]]|<ref name="Featurette">{{SW|url=video/sphere-of-influence-episode-featurette|text="Sphere of Influence" Episode Featurette}}</ref>}}
This is the first Nimbanel to appear in an episode of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series.
